items.desc: Live product feed for Google Merchant
Magento Google Shopping Feed is an extension that allows you to auto-generate product feed XML files and auto-update them to keep product data always up-to-date
🔍👨🏻‍💻️Validates Google Merchant product feeds by streaming XML RSS feeds via Java and push notifications to an Angular front-end via WebSockets.
An XML Product feed implementation for Google Merchant Shopping
Magento 1.x - Product XML feed for Google Merchant Center
